---
name: Factor-search experiment
about: Propose a theorem, search reduction, or benchmark
---

## Mathematical claim

Give the precise hypotheses and conclusion. Link the primary source and the upstream license if your change includes code.

## Experiment

Give an input family and a baseline. Specify the observable improvement, such as a smaller proven interval or fewer seconds from input to a checked prime list. Include a case outside the hypotheses.

## Lean target

Identify the statement to formalize or the existing declarations that certify the result.
